text: Warning: package early development. API may change without notice used production. hydrocan provides unified access Canadian hydrometric data diverse web-published sources. complementary tidyhydat, covers federal Water Survey Canada (WSC) network. hydrocan adds provincial utility networks existing R package. Every function returns consistent tibble regardless underlying data source, analysis code works unchanged new sources added.

title: List registered data sources — hc_list_sources
text: Returns summary data sources currently available via hydrocan, including description data types support. network calls made.

title: List registered data sources — hc_list_sources
text: tibble columns name (chr), description (chr), has_flows (lgl), has_daily_flows (lgl), has_stations (lgl).

title: Retrieve daily flow summaries — hc_read_daily_flows
text: Returns one value per station per calendar day published data source. data sources publish daily data; produce warning return rows affected stations.

title: Retrieve daily flow summaries — hc_read_daily_flows
code: hc_read_daily_flows(   station_number,   start_date,   end_date = Sys.Date(),   source = NULL )

title: Retrieve daily flow summaries — hc_read_daily_flows
text: station_number Character vector station identifiers. start_date Start requested period (Date, character coercible Date). end_date End requested period (Date, character coercible Date). Defaults today. source Optional single character string naming data source use directly. NULL (default) source detected automatically station number. See hc_list_sources() available names.

title: Retrieve daily flow summaries — hc_read_daily_flows
text: tibble columns station_number (chr), date (Date), value (dbl), parameter (chr), units (chr), source (chr), approval (chr), quality_flag (chr).

title: Retrieve sub-daily flow observations — hc_read_flows
text: Fetches sub-daily observations one stations across requested date range. data source determined automatically station number, fixed explicitly via source.

title: Retrieve sub-daily flow observations — hc_read_flows
code: hc_read_flows(station_number, start_date, end_date = Sys.Date(), source = NULL)

title: Retrieve sub-daily flow observations — hc_read_flows
text: station_number Character vector station identifiers. start_date Start requested period (Date, character coercible Date). end_date End requested period (Date, character coercible Date). Defaults today. source Optional single character string naming data source use directly. NULL (default) source detected automatically station number. See hc_list_sources() available names.

title: Retrieve sub-daily flow observations — hc_read_flows
text: tibble columns station_number (chr), datetime (POSIXct UTC), value (dbl), parameter (chr), units (chr), source (chr), approval (chr), quality_flag (chr).

title: Retrieve station metadata — hc_read_stations
text: Returns location period--record information stations available across registered data sources. Data sources publish station metadata skipped warning.

title: Retrieve station metadata — hc_read_stations
text: source Optional single character string naming data source query directly. NULL (default) registered data sources queried. See hc_list_sources() available names.

title: Retrieve station metadata — hc_read_stations
text: tibble columns station_number (chr), station_name (chr), source (chr), longitude (dbl), latitude (dbl), elevation_m (dbl), period_start (Date), period_end (Date), notes (list).

text: Constructs validated adapter object data source. least one fetch_flows_fn fetch_daily_flows_fn must supplied.

title: Create a hydrocan adapter — new_hydrocan_adapter
code: new_hydrocan_adapter(   name,   description,   list_stations_fn,   fetch_flows_fn = NULL,   fetch_daily_flows_fn = NULL,   list_stations_meta_fn = NULL )

title: Create a hydrocan adapter — new_hydrocan_adapter
text: name Non-empty string identifying source. Used registry key source column output. description String describing source known limitations (e.g. rolling data window). Shown hc_list_sources(). list_stations_fn Function arguments returning character vector station IDs source can serve. fetch_flows_fn Optional function(station_number, start_date, end_date) returning tibble matching flows schema (datetime column). NULL sub-daily data available. fetch_daily_flows_fn Optional function(station_number, start_date, end_date) returning tibble matching daily flows schema (date column). NULL daily data available. list_stations_meta_fn Optional function arguments returning tibble matching stations schema. NULL station metadata available.
